# Preview Videos

A Lens preview video helps users visualize your Lens experience before unlocking the Lens. Think of it as a mini trailer for your creation. Previews make your Lenses more compelling and will be visible to the public.

## Preview Video, Best Practices[​**](#preview-video-best-practices "Copy to clipboard")

When creating a preview for your Lens, keep the following best practices in mind:

* Make sure the entirety of the preview video includes the defining elements of the Lens. For example, if your Lens is a face experience, show the Lens applied to a face.
* Sometimes, your preview video will be displayed as a static image. Because of this, make sure the first frame of your video is compelling and shows off the defining elements of the Lens.
* Keep your preview videos short and to the point.
* Make sure your preview videos are nicely lit.
* Avoid busy backgrounds as they might distract from the content of your Lens.
* Do note that the [Submission Guidelines](/lens-studio/publishing/submitting/submission-guidelines.md) apply to both the Lens and your Lens preview video.
* Keep preview videos at a 9:16 aspect ratio (vertical video).
* Keep preview videos under 32 MB for videos.

It's best to provide a .mp4 formatted video. One way to do this is to use the following settings for [FFMPEG](https://www.ffmpeg.org/):  `ffmpeg -i my_video.MOV -vcodec h264 -acodec mp2 my_video.mp4`

## Adding Preview Video, Pre Submission[​**](#adding-preview-video-pre-submission "Copy to clipboard")

There are two ways to add a Lens preview video, through the `Project Info` settings or `My Lenses` submission process.

### Project Settings[​**](#project-settings "Copy to clipboard")

If you click on the `Project Settings` button in Lens Studio's toolbar, you will see various settings to configure your Lens Project.

![](/assets/images/preview-video-1-62314e4aa486125175fe7beaf009c402.png)

Click on `+` in the right-side of the window where `Lens Preview` is, or select the `Preview` tab in the left-side of the window to go into the Lens' Preview settings.

If you've added a preview previously, you can click on the preview to change it.

In the `Preview` section, you can choose:

* A pre-made video to apply your Lens to, which gives you a quick and convenient way to create a preview video for your Lens.
  <!-- -->
  * To do this: select one of the pre-generated video.

* or upload your own preview videos. You have the option to select the box:

  <!-- -->

  * `Upload Video Without Lens` if you then want Lens Studio to overlay the Lens on top of it.
  * `Upload Video With Lens` if you want your Lens to use the preview video as is.

For more information about the Project Settings window, please refer to the [Configuring Project Settings](/lens-studio/publishing/configuring/configuring-project-info.md) guide.

![](/assets/images/preview-video-2-e407f32956e5ff3efb4a88d198f3b319.png)

### My Lenses Submission[​**](#my-lenses-submission "Copy to clipboard")

You can also submit your Lens preview during the Lens Submission process. In the Lens detail section you can click `Add Snapchat Lens Preview` button.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

This will take you to the `Lens Preview` window. Click the `Choose file or drag and drop` button, or drag your file to the box to add your preview.

![](/assets/images/preview-video-4-f4f012a6313ae249ee7378ffbf6e6109.png)

Once uploaded, the preview video will go into review. The message `To be Reviewed` will be shown until the preview video is approved.

![](/assets/images/preview-video-5-6b02adbe18e34264691dd6f2d4030879.png)

Once the preview has been added, click `Apply`.

If you have added your Lens preview in the Project Info, there is no need to add another one. Since one Lens can only have one preview, adding another preview video here will replace the one you added earlier in the Project Info.

## Updating or Adding Preview Video, Post Submission[​**](#updating-or-adding-preview-video-post-submission "Copy to clipboard")

You can always submit your Lens and add the preview video later. This also applies to any Lenses submitted before the preview video functionality was added. To add or update a preview video after submission, first open [My Lenses](https://my-lenses.snapchat.com/) by selecting `My Lenses` in the top right side of your Lens Studio project. Then, find your Lens entry and click it.

![](/assets/images/preview-video-6-218f458f4ba6032ea9b400cb4174fb89.png)

This will take you to the My Lens page. Click the `Add Snapchat Lens Preview` button to add your preview.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Like before, here you can add your preview video and then press `Apply`.
